case.summary: The investigation concludes with a legitimate verdict (fraud probability 0.10) for in-person transaction 3640919 ($881.55) in billing region 494.0. Region 494.0 is familiar to card C09241-K2 with 491 prior transactions, and prior alert CC-1257 was cleared for travel. The customer confirmed travel to region 494.0 and recognized the purchase. Recommended actions are CREATE_CASE, ALLOW_TRANSACTION, and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD under Rule R3.
